k-jensen.title: Jensen Huang ouster rumours and $HUANG coins
k-jensen.sourceSays: Posts say Nvidia's Jensen Huang is tied to a suspected spy and smuggled-chip claims and that a board may oust him; others joke about his name. All claims are unverified.
k-jensen.reason: Posts of Nov 11-13 discuss the Huang ouster claims (KTRH News) and the 'huang' meme that the coins' names and description draw on; the allegations are unverified.
